title: Largest ice caps and icefields
measure: Area in km² of the largest glacier complexes: ice caps, icefields and other connected masses of glacier ice. The two great ice sheets, covering Antarctica and Greenland, are left out. From a 2022 study by the US National Snow and Ice Data Center and the World Glacier Monitoring Service. Ice outlines date from 1972 to 2015, and many have shrunk since.

entries.name: Antarctic Peninsula ice
entries.note: By far the largest, but it's joined to the Antarctic Ice Sheet, and is often counted as part of it.
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Alexander Island
entries.note: Not counting the ice shelves joined to it.
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Malaspina-Seward
entries.note: The largest outside the Arctic and Antarctic. Malaspina Glacier, its biggest part, spreads across the coastal plain like a giant pancake.
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Severny Island Northern Ice Cap
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Northern Ellesmere Icefield
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Prince of Wales Icefield
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Agassiz Ice Cap
entries.note: Three of the top ten are on Ellesmere Island.
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Southern Patagonian Icefield
entries.note: The largest in the Southern Hemisphere outside Antarctica.
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Thurston Island
entries.note: Its outline dates from 1972, the oldest in the top ten.
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS

entries.name: Flade Isblink
entries.note: The largest ice cap around Greenland that isn't part of its ice sheet.
entries.source: Windnagel et al., Which glaciers are the largest in the world?, Journal of Glaciology (2022), from the Randolph Glacier Inventory and GLIMS
